overview_description.description:
Zopa is a P2P money lending service that allows lenders and borrowers to deal directly with one another, cutting out the banks that act as middlemen. Zopa provides an app designed to help users manage their loans, credit cards, and savings and monitor their credit scores conveniently.  

Zopa also mitigates lenders' risk by enforcing monthly direct debit repayment, making borrowers sign a legal contract, and allowing lenders to lend small chunks of money to individual borrowers (e.g., someone lending £1000 would have their money spread across, say, 100 borrowers).

The company itself makes money by charging a fixed fee for borrowers and a 1% annual fee for lenders.

Zopa has received public acclaim as well, having been awarded CNET Technology Awards' 2006 Internet Innovation of the Year, the 2007 Webby Award for Best Banking/Bill-Paying Website, the 2008 Webby Award for Financial Services, the Banker 2007 Award for Best Internet Project, and Moneywise 2009 Awards for Best Customer Service and Best Personal Loan.

about_short_description.short_description: Zopa is a online bank that offers peer-to-peer lending platform, offering deposit accounts, personal loans, and credit cards.

product.name: Biscuit by Zopa
product.description: A digital current account for everyday banking, offering interest on balances, cashback on eligible Direct Debits, a debit card and app-based account management.

product.name: Personal loans
product.description: Unsecured fixed-term loans for personal borrowing, including purposes such as debt consolidation, home improvements, weddings and car purchases.

product.name: Zopa Credit Card
product.description: A consumer credit card for purchases and spending management, with account access, eligibility checking and digital payment support through the Zopa app.

product.name: Savings accounts
product.description: Consumer savings products that let customers hold cash in flexible or fixed-term accounts, including easy-access, fixed-term and regular saver options.

product.name: Cash ISA
product.description: A tax-advantaged savings account that allows UK consumers to earn interest on cash without paying tax on the interest, subject to ISA rules and limits.

product.name: Stocks & Shares ISA
product.description: A tax-advantaged investment account for holding eligible investments, allowing customers to seek long-term growth without paying tax on investment returns within ISA rules.
